case.subject: Elements.cloud (Business Analysis Software Company)
case.problem: The "Case-to-Bug" process—the workflow between a customer reporting a software issue and the development team initiating a fix—was manual, inefficient, and prone to miscommunication and delays.
case.workflow: The team integrated an AI agent into their Salesforce environment to handle the end-to-end case-to-bug lifecycle. The agent monitors incoming cases, analyzes them for context and technical relevance, and autonomously drives the steps required to prepare the issue for the development team.
case.result: The company successfully transformed a chaotic, manual process into a streamlined, automated workflow, resulting in improved speed, accuracy, and efficiency in issue resolution within four weeks.
case.result_basis: Reported by Elements.cloud in a documented company case study.
case.measurement_context: Transition from a manual, delay-prone case-to-bug reporting process to an AI-orchestrated workflow.
case.source_quote: Through a systematic approach that combined process analysis and strategic AI implementation, we were able to transform this workflow into a model of speed, accuracy,
case.limitation: The case study focuses on an internal process improvement for a B2B tech company, which may require specific Salesforce infrastructure to replicate.
case.listener_action: Map out your most common "ticket-to-resolution" workflow and identify one manual, multi-step handover point where an AI agent could ingest data and draft or execute the next action.
case.availability: Current; available via Salesforce Agentforce platform.
